primary_title: LRP1 is the cell-surface endocytosis receptor for vaspin in adipocytes
decision_basis: The review identifies the cited primary study showing native/polymerized vaspin binding to LRP1 and rapid clathrin-mediated internalization in adipocytes, with LRP1 knockdown/rescue and lysosomal targeting.
